Card Q&A.a: It means the total number of cards in both you and your opponent's security stacks. For example, if you have 3 cards in your security stack and your opponent has 2 cards in their security stack, the total security cards will be 5 cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "total cards in both players' security stacks" in this card's [On Play] effect mean?

Effect: [On Play] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, you may play 1 yellow Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.
